entities.summary: Alexis Youlo Touabli is an Ivorian Catholic prelate who was appointed Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of San Pedro-en-Côte d'Ivoire, in Ivory Coast on 22 October 2025. Before that, from 14 October 2006 until 22 October 2025, he was the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Agboville, Ivory Coast. He was appointed bishop of Agboville, by Pope Benedict XVI. He was consecrated and installed at Agboville, Diocese of Agboville on 16 December 2006 by Barthélémy Djabla, Archbishop of Gagnoa. On 22 October 2025, Pope Leo XIV transferred him to the Diocese of San Pedro-en-Côte d'Ivoire, Ivory Coast and appointed him the local ordinary there.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Bishop of Agboville and later San Pedro-en-Côte d'Ivoire, Alexis Touably Youlo played a crucial role in shaping Catholicism's presence in Ivory Coast, with his appointment by Pope Benedict XVI and subsequent transfer by Pope Leo XIV marking significant milestones in the diocese's leadership.
